sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_1D: Input your The Finals mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse → Sensitivity. Include ADS sensitivity multiplier and FOV setting.
steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_2D: Choose the game to convert to. The Finals' fast movement and destruction mechanics create a unique aiming feel — converted sensitivity may need adjustment.
steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_3D: Apply the converted value. Test in Quick Cash mode for a low-stakes environment to dial in your sensitivity before tournament play.
